context.body: Royal succession and moral memory occupy a single compressed line.

observations.body: Matthew traces David’s line through the wife of Uriah to Solomon, then through Rehoboam.
observations.label: Solomon enters Jesus’ genealogy: action

observations.body: Solomon is remembered inside a genealogy that retains the shadow of David’s act against Uriah.
observations.label: Solomon enters Jesus’ genealogy: response

payload.posture: Read Matthew 1:6–7 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The genealogy names the line without evaluating Solomon’s reign or resolving the violence behind his birth context.
